_about: Round 16 (2026-11-26): real recordings for common sounds (Anthony: 'yes on 6 too'). Current is the round 14 winner (layered effects, pro mix), every sound generated. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json and variants_layers.json.

variants.label: Real recordings where they fit
variants.why: Key moments, their whoosh and detail layers and the room background are looked for in a library of public-domain real recordings first. Claude reads the closest recordings' labels and uses one only when it clearly fits; everything else is generated as before.

variants.label: Real recordings for key moments only
variants.why: The same, but the steady background of the room stays generated, in case a recorded room tone stands out.
